474:t_012:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Uh-oh! At this rate it's going to set off a huge explosion that takes out everything around it!」

474:t_012:2.en:
$$シンジ$$
「No way...! Then what about $$竜馬$$!」

474:t_013:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「A $$ゲッター$$ Robo... other than me...!」

474:t_013:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Don't make me laugh, $$竜馬$$. We're not about to lose to you, now that you've sunk to the level of the Invaders.」

474:t_015:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$竜馬$$! Putting you out of your misery is a job we'll take on ourselves!」

474:t_017:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$弁慶$$, let me take over.」

474:t_018:0.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$... I'll deliver the finishing blow myself.」

474:t_018:2.en:
???
「What a beautiful friendship, $$スティンガー$$.」

474:t_019:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$!」

474:t_019:3.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「It's been a while, everyone.」

474:t_019:5.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$... They used to be researchers of the $$ゲッター線$$, just like Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$, who developed $$ゲッター$$ Robo, but...」

474:t_019:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「Now they've been parasitized by the Invaders and have completely merged with them.」

474:t_019:7.en:
$$ボス$$
「Those guys...! I thought they were at the center of the galaxy, but they went out of their way to come all the way to Earth!」

474:t_019:8.en:
$$隼人$$
「Have you come to watch the end of $$竜馬$$, your archenemy?」

474:t_019:9.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「What a pity. I had thought that he, as one chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$ just as we were, would become our comrade.」

474:t_019:10.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Yes. It is truly a pity.」

474:t_019:11.en:
$$隼人$$
「I don't intend to let you have your way with $$竜馬$$.」

474:t_020:2.en:
$$弁慶$$
「You're going to be the one to finish $$竜馬$$ off!?」

474:t_020:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「What I'm going to do is this!」

474:t_021:0.en:
$$號$$
(Photon Power and the $$ゲッター線$$ are becoming one now...!)

474:t_021:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Wake up, $$流竜馬$$! Is this all you amount to!?」

474:t_021:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「He knocked some sense into him with the Big Bang Punch!?」

474:t_021:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's absurd! It goes beyond all understanding!」

474:t_021:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's the reverse of the usual pattern.」

474:t_021:6.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Come to think of it, we once took a nasty hit from $$竜馬$$ ourselves.」

474:t_021:9.en:
$$コーウェン$$
「You've done something quite pointless.」

474:t_021:10.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「Well, no matter. Then we will deliver the finishing blow.」

474:t_022:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...Keep it down, $$甲児$$. Don't yell that loud the second I wake up.」

474:t_023:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're in the way, you damn thing!」

474:t_024:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You went too far, you guys. $$ブラックゲッター$$ is practically scrap now!」

474:t_025:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Now, now, don't be like that.」

474:t_025:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「Blame some idiot who just kept sleeping.」

474:t_025:3.en:
$$隼人$$
「Hurry up, $$竜馬$$. The Invaders are waiting for you.」

474:t_026:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Like I thought, a $$ゲッター$$ Robo is only right with three aboard!」

474:t_026:1.en:
$$凱$$
「What!? $$真ゲッター$$'s power is rising!」

474:t_026:2.en:
$$號$$
($$竜馬$$... So you've learned how to sync your own will with the $$ゲッター線$$ through Photon Power.)

474:t_026:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come on, $$號$$! Let's make that thing taste how terrifying $$ゲッター$$ can be!」

474:t_027:1.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's too late to try to run away!」

474:t_027:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「We'll take you on your own way.」

474:t_027:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Brace yourselves! This is the power of $$ゲッター$$!!」

474:t_028:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Now we're talking, you guys! That's as hot as it gets!」

474:t_028:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't underestimate us. This is just business as usual for us.」

474:t_029:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That hit home, $$甲児$$. That punch of yours.」

474:t_029:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「As a get-well present, I'll back you up! Cut loose and go wild!」

474:t_030:1.en:
$$スティンガー$$
「How fearsome, $$ゲッター$$ Robo! How fearsome, $$流竜馬$$!」

474:t_030:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$コーウェン$$! $$スティンガー$$! I'm a human being!」

474:t_030:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're right, I used to be like a stray dog, thinking everyone who came near me was an enemy...」

474:t_030:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But I changed! By meeting my comrades and $$ゲッター$$ Robo!」
